name: Browser Use
notes: Requires Python 3.11+. The CLI delegates to Browser Harness; inventory reads the Python package version. Configure browser/runtime access separately.

name: Nanobot
notes: Requires Python 3.11+. Configure a model provider before running the agent.

name: ZeroClaw
notes: Installs the prebuilt Unix runtime; run zeroclaw quickstart separately to configure providers and channels.

name: IronClaw
notes: Uses the upstream release installer. Initial provider and service setup is separate.

name: Docker Agent
notes: Homebrew installs the standalone CLI. Docker Desktop 4.63+ also includes the docker agent plugin; plugin-only installations are not detected by this entry.

name: Unreal Agent
notes: Homebrew distributes a cask (macOS). The Unix source build requires Go 1.27+ and links unreal-agent-tui into ~/.local/bin. Upstream exposes no documented version flag.

name: Dirac
notes: The CLI package is dirac-cli. Requires Node >=22.13 and <25.

name: VT Code
notes: The upstream native installer may also install optional search tools. Homebrew installs the CLI through the verified tap.

name: iCode
notes: Requires Python 3.14+. Upstream describes the project as work in progress.

name: Happy
notes: The original Happy CLI is published as happy; happy-coder is the former package name. Requires an existing supported coding agent.

name: Sno Station
notes: The upstream installer initializes Sno and may add its bin directory to the shell profile. Run sno setup separately to configure Station and agent integrations.

name: agent-memory
notes: Not published to PyPI. Builds from the upstream workspace into the AgentManager data directory and links mem into ~/.local/bin; requires Python 3.12+. The CLI has no version flag. Hook and MCP configuration is a separate explicit setup step.

name: macOS Harness
notes: macOS only; upstream recommends Python 3.12. Run macos-harness install --agent NAME and macos-harness doctor separately, then grant the macOS permissions reported by doctor.

name: fauxnix
notes: Windows with PowerShell 5.1+ and Node 22.20+. The package is fauxnix-cli, not the unrelated fauxnix npm package. Agent integration is configured separately.

name: Only CLI / oc
notes: Requires Node 20+. The oc command conflicts with Red Hat OpenShift. If OpenShift is installed, use npx @only-cli/oc instead of a global installation. Detection uses the npm package identity.

name: Foremerge
notes: The npm package bundles release binaries for macOS and glibc Linux; no Windows npm package is published. Run foremerge setup separately to configure integrations.

name: Leviathan
notes: The Rust package is leviathan-index; its executable is leviathan.

name: OpenQodex
notes: Requires Node 22+ on macOS or Linux. Global npm installation adds the CLI only; run openqodex init separately to review and authorize project/agent setup. Full review requires an authenticated Claude Code or Codex installation.

name: tsk
notes: Agent and Herdr integrations are separate setup steps. Version probing is disabled because upstream documents --help rather than a stable version flag.

name: Plannotator TUI
notes: Homebrew 6 may require trusting plannotator/tap first. The optional Herdr add-on is installed separately.

name: Moltis
notes: Primary interactive surface is the browser UI; this entry manages the gateway CLI.

name: Symphony
notes: Engineering preview. Installs a stable self-contained Unix release with checksum verification. Supply a configured WORKFLOW.md and tracker credentials separately; no version probe is run.

name: open_scion
notes: Early v0.1.0 source build; not Anthropic Scion. Builds bundled Git and links graft into ~/.local/bin. Requires Go 1.26, a C toolchain, Meson and Ninja. Configure and run a Graft server separately; no version probe is run.
